description: This file contains multiple classes related to Orleans grains, including grain implementations, call filters, exception classes, and observer interfaces. It demonstrates method interception, call filtering, error handling, and attribute usage within the Orleans framework for distributed virtual actors.

classes.name: OutgoingMethodInterceptionGrain
classes.description: Implements an outgoing method call, including an echo method that calls another grain and a method that throws an exception based on input.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing call filtering logic, intercepting method calls for behaviors such as short-circuiting, exception handling, and result modification. Includes nested custom exception and attribute classes.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrain.MyDomainSpecificException
classes.description: A custom serializable exception class used within MethodInterceptionGrain.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrain.MessWithResultAttribute
classes.description: Attribute used to indicate methods where the result should be modified in the call filter.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrainObserver
classes.description: Observer implementation of grain call filters, similar to the grain class but for observer grains.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrainObserver.MyDomainSpecificException
classes.description: A nested custom exception class within the observer class.

classes.name: MethodInterceptionGrainObserver.MessWithResultAttribute
classes.description: Attribute class for observer grain method interception.

classes.name: GenericMethodInterceptionGrain<T>
classes.description: A generic grain that intercepts method calls based on method name, demonstrating generic type handling.

classes.name: TrickyInterceptionGrain
classes.description: Grain with multiple overloads of GetInputAsString with different parameter types, demonstrating interception based on method signatures.

classes.name: GenericMethodInterceptionGrainObserver<T>
classes.description: Observer version of the generic method interception grain.

classes.name: TrickyInterceptionGrainObserver
classes.description: Observer version of the tricky grain with multiple overloads.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterTestGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing a call filter that demonstrates retries, context manipulation, and method interception with various behaviors including exceptions and short-circuits.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterTestGrainObserver
classes.description: Observer implementation of the GrainCallFilterTestGrain, with similar call filtering logic.

classes.name: CaterpillarGrain
classes.description: Grain implementing method call filtering with context validation and attribute-based tagging, demonstrating request context usage and method metadata validation.

methods.name: EchoViaOtherGrain
methods.description: Calls another grain's Echo method with a message, returns the result in a dictionary.

methods.name: ThrowIfGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException if the input value is greater than zero, otherwise returns a thank you message.

methods.name: One
methods.description: Method that throws InvalidOperationException to simulate restricted access.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Returns the input argument, with attribute decoration for interception.

methods.name: NotIntercepted
methods.description: Returns a fixed string indicating it was not intercepted.

methods.name: FilterThrows
methods.description: Method that throws an exception to demonstrate filter handling.

methods.name: SystemWideCallFilterMarker
methods.description: Marker method for system-wide call filter.

methods.name: IncorrectResultType
methods.description: Returns a string but set to return a GUID in the filter to demonstrate invalid cast.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Implementation of IIncomingGrainCallFilter.Invoke(), handles method interception logic including short-circuit, exception handling, and result modification.

methods.name: GetInputAsString
methods.description: Method that returns the string representation of the input argument.

methods.name: GetBestNumber
methods.description: Returns a fixed number, demonstrating other method interception.

methods.name: Eat
methods.description: Method with attribute test tag; checks for context tags.

methods.name: Invoke (CaterpillarGrain)
methods.description: Validate method and interface attributes, and invoke the context.
